proposed_widenings.name: grant_action_as_bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Conjure Woodland Beings grants the caster the ability to take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration. No v4 atom covers lowering the action-economy cost of a standard action to a bonus action. deny_opportunity_attack is not equivalent: Disengage prevents triggering opportunity attacks when leaving threatened squares on any movement, not just a single OA suppression. grant_extra_action only grants an additional main-action quota, not a bonus-action-cost variant of an existing action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: In addition, you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.once_per_turn_dedup_predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: Conjure Woodland Beings (and Spirit Guardians, Web, Cloudkill) all include the clause 'A creature makes this save only once per turn.' The current OngoingOperation has no predicate variant for cross-trigger dedup within a single turn. Without this, encoding both on_creature_enters_area and on_creature_ends_turn_in_area triggers for the same save_gate would incorrectly imply two independent saves are possible per turn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffect.save_gate.optional
proposed_widenings.justification: The save in Conjure Woodland Beings is triggered at the caster's discretion: 'you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw.' The save is not mandatory on every qualifying trigger. The current OngoingEffect.save_gate has no optional flag; it always fires when the trigger condition is met.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw

notes: Partial encoding: the entry-triggered Wisdom save_gate (5d8 Force, half on success, slot-scaled +1d8 per slot above 4) was encoded using on_creature_enters_area. The on_creature_ends_turn_in_area sibling trigger was deferred — without a once-per-turn dedup predicate, including both would misrepresent RAW. The optional save (caster chooses whether to force it) is encoded as mandatory; this is a surface_widening gap noted in proposals. The Disengage-as-Bonus-Action grant is entirely omitted due to the atom_widening gap. Typecheck passes; tracer emits a clean graph.
